subject.title: GitHub OAuth consent still shows personal ClawdHub / steipete branding (reopen of #2524)

question: Which authorized owner will transfer or recreate the production GitHub OAuth App under official OpenClaw ownership and rotate ClawHub’s production credentials?
rationale: The repair requires control of the current GitHub OAuth App and production Convex secrets, so repository automation cannot safely perform or validate the privileged change.

options.title: Transfer existing app
options.body: Move the current OAuth App to official OpenClaw ownership, correct its branding and URLs, rotate credentials as needed, and validate both authentication flows.

options.title: Create replacement app
options.body: Create a new officially owned OAuth App, update production credentials and callbacks, validate it, and then retire the personal application.

options.title: Retain personal ownership
options.body: Keep the current application only after an explicit project-owner decision documents the trust, access, and continuity model.

recommendation.title: Transfer existing app
recommendation.body: Move the current OAuth App to official OpenClaw ownership, correct its branding and URLs, rotate credentials as needed, and validate both authentication flows.

likelyOwner.reason: They were assigned the predecessor covering the same operational change and are the best available routing candidate beyond the current application owner.
